items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He wanted to fight me. I insulted his wife.

ctx.x: Danny took me down to the Cotton Club to make this audition, and I was singing the blues, and I sang "Don't You Feel My Leg," you know. And Bill Robinson's wife, oh, she was enjoyin' it! All of those chorus girls and everybody was enjoying what I was doing, you know. All of a sudden, here comes Bill Robinson talking about me singing that kind of stuff in front of his wife.
Right in the back. He wanted to fight me. I insulted his wife.

So then she got all (?) and quiet and lookin' all innocent. And she was the one enjoying it more than anybody else! But he comes in. And that stopped me from getting a job. But I can't hide(?) ...(?).
